outcome: fetal biometry (biparietal diameter, abdominal circumference, femur length, estimated fetal weight)
cohort: Pregnant women evaluated between 2021 and 2023 at a hospital in Northern Mexico, categorized by their glycemic status.
finding: Fetuses of women with type 2 diabetes mellitus exhibited smaller fetal biometric parameters and neonatal birth weight compared to healthy women, despite adequate metabolic control.
